A1.justification: Both PDFs describe River-LLM. Their text, equations, nine figures, six tables, and complete appendices support reliable comparison; the additional page in v3 primarily reflects bibliography expansion and reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original accuracy, throughput, latency, KV-similarity, and memory experiments in Sections 3–5 and Appendices A.1–A.3.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including benchmark evaluations, quantization-backend comparisons, and memory measurements.

M1.justification: The KV-shared Exit River, quantized exit layers, cosine-similarity exit decision, prefill/generation procedures, and backbone offloading remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate BoolQ, HellaSwag, ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, MMLU, GSM8K, MATH, and HumanEval. The long-context memory scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: backbone/full quantization in Table 3, the four alternative KV strategies in Figures 3 and 8, HQQ/AWQ configurations in Table 4, and Balcony/EE-LLM in the memory comparisons.

E3.justification: The same four model configurations, NVIDIA A40 hardware, shot settings, exit thresholds, batch-size-one generation tests, metrics, and 4K–64K memory evaluation settings are reported.

E4.justification: The KV-similarity analysis, exit-depth fidelity analysis, accuracy-throughput trade-offs, quantization-backend comparison, and memory-scaling analysis are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Both versions report averages over 10 tests in Section 5.3 and the same correlation/significance reporting in Figure 6. No repeated-run, seed, or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables and plotted results remain unchanged, but two reported findings are corrected. The headline speedup minimum becomes 1.53×, already present for Phi4-mini on MATH in Table 3. Section 5.2 replaces HumanEval outperformance with an accuracy match, consistent with Table 2's 57.3 for both the Llama3.1 8B backbone and River-LLM at threshold 0.7.

T1.justification: The seamless-exit conditions, cosine-similarity decision rule in Equation 1, and O(d) decision-cost argument are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction revise the claimed practical speedup range from 1.71–2.16× to 1.53–2.16×. The core training-free, KV-sharing contributions are unchanged; the conclusion still states the earlier range.

C2.justification: Despite correcting the HumanEval performance observation, v3 retains the same noise/overthinking explanation and broader interpretations of KV integrity and memory savings. The limitations concerning larger models and prefill-dominant workloads are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility descriptions remain unchanged, including W4A16 exit weights, FP16 KV caches, HQQ, compilation optimization, hardware, and offloading. No new River-LLM code or data availability is reported.

R1.justification: The same cited works and research positioning are retained, including the mixed-precision discussion in Appendix A.4. Expanded author lists and revised dates, venues, links, and MiniCache metadata are bibliographic updates.

P1.justification: There are targeted wording and terminology edits, standardized references, and expanded bibliographic entries. The main narrative, section ordering, and Appendix A.1–A.4 organization remain intact.

P2.justification: All nine figures and six tables are retained. Table 1 and Figure 6 receive caption edits; footer page numbers disappear, and bibliography/appendix reflow moves Table 6 from the left to the right column and extends Appendix A.4 onto another page.

improvement.justification: v3 improves agreement between prose and existing evidence by correcting the headline speedup minimum and the unsupported HumanEval outperformance statement. These are useful reporting corrections, although the conclusion retains the incorrect 1.71× minimum and the experimental evidence is unchanged.
